classes.name: ProblemIdElement
classes.description: Represents a DOM element for a problem identifier with display name and related properties.

classes.name: ProblemSummary
classes.description: Contains summary information for a problem, such as problem ID and count.

classes.name: ProblemNodeGroup
classes.description: Groups multiple problem nodes, possibly representing a collection with a common parent.

classes.name: TreeNode
classes.description: A general class for representing nodes in a tree structure, possibly used for problems, messages, or locations.

classes.name: TreeView
classes.description: A UI component for displaying trees of ProblemIdElements, ProblemSummary, etc.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message with severity, documentation links, and other metadata.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents locations related to problems, such as file locations and plugin locations.

classes.name: InputTree
classes.description: Nested tree structure for inputs related to problems.

classes.name: IncompatibleTaskTree
classes.description: Tree structure representing incompatible tasks related to problems.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Main data model encapsulating the state of the report, including problem nodes, messages, locations, and UI state.

methods.name: listProblems
methods.description: Function that initiates listing or fetching problem data, possibly from the cache or server.

methods.name: updateTree
methods.description: Updates tree structures in the UI with new data.

methods.name: expandCollapseAll
methods.description: Expands or collapses all nodes in a given tree view.

methods.name: copyReport
methods.description: Copies the report content to the clipboard.

methods.name: initializeReportPage
methods.description: Sets up the report page, including UI setup and data binding.
